paper.warnSplitClosed: Split declared during the trade: the close is not rewritten and this result is excluded from the statistics.
paper.warnSplitPending: Split declared after the proposal: the levels are no longer comparable and it is not executed.
paper.thesisNotAnchored: No anchored thesis: there was no saved thesis when the proposal was created, or it predates anchoring.
paper.superseded: The thesis has changed since then (current: v{latest}); the result does not validate the new version.
paper.stillCurrent: It is still the current thesis.
paper.notAnOrder: Simulated trade with no real capital. It is not a broker order.
paper.convictionNote: The stated conviction is not a validated probability of success. The levels are a proposal, not execution prices.
paper.priceSource: Price source: {source} · Dates in Madrid time.
paper.netResult: Simulated net result (after assumed costs and dividends): {value} {currency}
paper.costs: Simulated costs (assumption, not a broker fee): entry {entry} · exit {exit}.
paper.wrongCurrency: {count} in another currency ignored, never converted.
paper.queued: Generation in progress; reload the page in a few minutes to see the proposals.
paper.feedError: Couldn't queue the generation. Please try again.
paper.heading: AI paper results
paper.intro: Tracking of the model's paper proposals, not of your manual trades.
paper.empty: No model proposals recorded. No paper trade has been generated to show.
paper.basisText: Win = positive gross result at close. Currencies are kept separate. Net deducts modelled costs (assumption: fixed fee + spread, stored per trade) and adds declared dividends (unofficial source; uncertain events excluded; another currency is never converted). Splits: open positions are adjusted with a source; a closed one with a split is not rewritten and is excluded from the hit rate. No short financing, FX, cash ledger or capital. An early exit does not validate a 5-year thesis. Simulated quantity: assumption.
paper.calUnavailable: Calibration not available. Conviction cannot be evaluated with this data.
paper.calClosed: {closed} LLM proposals closed with a result, out of {total} recorded.
paper.calInsufficient: Sample too small: {closed} closed; minimum {min}. Results are indicative and do not validate predictive ability.
paper.notReturn: It is not a return or a guarantee.
paper.caption: Stated conviction vs. observed hit rate
